title: Pre-push post hook judges the pre-edit tree of a compound command (edit && commit && push)
problem: The three-dot diff landed in #11297, so other runs' posts no longer block. Still open: the hook runs before the whole Bash command, so `fix && git commit && git push` is judged on the tree before the fix and blocks the very command that repairs it (3 doc_friction reports 2026-10-29).
evidence: doc_friction 2026-10-29T01:09 and 01:11: push blocked over another session's merged 178-char post; merging main cleared it
doc_friction 2026-10-29T03:08: the hook blocked a compound commit+push, so the fix in the same command never ran
change: In .claude/hooks/check_posts_before_push.py exit 0 when the text before `git push` contains git add/commit/merge/checkout/restore or `sed -i` (CI still checks the post); add a case to test_check_posts_before_push.py. The auto-mode classifier denied this edit again on 2026-10-29 as self-modification, so it needs an owner or a session allowed to edit .claude/.
metric: doc_friction reports naming check_posts_before_push.py per 3 days
result: Helped: run records naming check_posts_before_push.py: 10 on 2026-10-29, 1 on 2026-10-30 (fix landed that day), none 2026-10-31 or 2026-11-01.

history.note: Hook skips the check when git add/commit/merge/checkout/restore/rebase/pull or sed -i precedes git push; test added.
